reviews.rationale: Sequential comparison of selected SEC exhibit rows for the two calendar quarters. The GAAP income statement rows move in a coherent direction: net interest income before provision rises, the credit loss provision is lower, and net interest income after provision rises by more than the pre-provision line, so the provision change reinforces rather than offsets the revenue-side move. Fee income and total noninterest income also rise, while compensation and total operating noninterest expense rise by more than noninterest income, so the expense side is a genuine offset rather than a confirmation. Pretax income and net income both rise, and income tax expense rises alongside pretax income, which is consistent with a larger tax base rather than a reduced tax burden; the tax line is therefore not evidence of a smaller tax drag. Tax credit and CRA investment amortization declines, which is a component of noninterest expense and is not treated as a driver of the profit change. On credit quality, the company-reported point-in-time criticized balance is modestly higher, with special mention lower and classified higher, so the composition shifts toward the more severe bucket even though the aggregate move is small. The thesis is a source-bounded research baseline with no valuation or conviction claim, so the appropriate research-state action is to maintain it at the existing conviction while recording the new source. Uncertainty: these are selected displayed rows, not complete filings; the extract contains no balance-sheet averages, no net interest margin, no non-GAAP reconciliation, no guidance, and no management explanation, so no causal attribution of the margin or provision moves is supported. The comparison is sequential only, not year-over-year, and no prior-year quarter is in evidence. Percent changes and percentage-point margin effects cannot be derived from the supplied rows. Evidence that would change the view: a full filing or earnings release showing net interest margin drivers, provision composition and reserve coverage, non-GAAP reconciliations, forward guidance, and year-over-year comparatives, plus any migration detail behind the criticized-loan composition shift.
